item.title: Does is matter if I call it a PoC or MVP?
item.description: In software development we run Proof of Concepts (PoCs), do Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), use DevOps and many other activities that have names that are more or less well defined. So when I want to get something done, does it matter what I call it? Yes! Or a longer answer, Yes, it matters in the context where other people interact with your activity, people that finance it, use the output or might fight against it.
